sources.snippet: The model is pre-trained on Kobza [HF], a large-scale Ukrainian corpus of nearly 60 billion tokens. Modern-LiBERTa builds on the ModernBERT architecture and is the first Ukrainian language model to support long-context encoding efficiently.
